name: deepseek-v4-flash-0731
licenseNote: COMMERCIAL-OK. MIT — repository and weights both MIT-licensed and ungated. Clears Safebux-metered serving AND IPFS/EBS redistribution with no separate license step (unlike the older DeepSeek-License checkpoints).

weights.note: 284B-param MoE (304B repo params incl. the attached DSpark speculative-decoding draft module), 13B active/token. Tensor types BF16/FP8_E4M3/I8. Capture per-shard SHA-256 from model.safetensors.index.json at the pinned main-branch commit at build. The DSpark draft ships INSIDE this checkpoint — no separate draft-model weights to fetch.

resources.recommendedGpu: Single 4×GB300 node for full BF16/FP8 serving (DeepSeek's own vLLM example). At aggressive GGUF quant: ~110 GB combined RAM+VRAM (8-bit ≈162 GB, 3-bit ≈103 GB, Unsloth dynamic builds). NOT a single-consumer-GPU runner — every expert stays resident even though only 13B activate/token.

sampling.topPNote: top_p=0.95 for agentic scenarios, 1.0 otherwise. temperature=1.0. Up to 384K output tokens at high/max reasoning effort.

trustRemoteCodeReview: REQUIRED before install. Every official launch command sets --trust-remote-code. Pin the main-branch commit, review the custom modeling code and the encoding_dsv4 package, and vet through the trust-or-simulate harness before promotion. Same gated posture as deepseek-v3, kimi-k3, kimi-linear-48b, nemotron-omni.
chatTemplateNote: NO Jinja chat template. The repo ships an encoding/ folder with encode_messages / parse_message_from_completion_text (import: encoding_dsv4). Serving via vLLM with --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 applies the built-in encoding so the OpenAI-compatible endpoint works without the helper scripts — the runner's templating path must NOT assume a Jinja template exists. Keep reasoning controls in chat_template_kwargs (reasoning_effort: low|high|max).
hardwareCaveat: Speculative decoding (DSpark/MTP) is UNAVAILABLE on sm_120 — both abort during warmup (sparse MLA kernel requires >64 tokens/batch; spec verification submits only the draft length). Disable the --speculative-config flag on sm_120 GPUs.
notes: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (official release, 2026-07-31): 284B MoE, 13B active, 1M context, MIT. Re-post-trained from the April preview (same architecture) — large agentic/coding jump; beats the far larger V4-Pro (Preview) on every agentic benchmark DeepSeek published (Terminal Bench 2.1 82.7, DeepSWE 54.4). Runs on the EXISTING vllm runner (also SGLang: --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --tp 4). ALL benchmark numbers are DeepSeek's own — treat as frontier-class, verify on your own agentic eval before betting. The HN 'very affordable' refers to DeepSeek's hosted API ($0.14/$0.28 per M tokens), which is irrelevant to in-box serving cost — self-hosting needs a 4×GB300-class node or a heavily-quantized large box.
